System Knowledge.content: Patch workflows for critical services must use diff-based patches, maintain backups, and create a patch diff before applying changes to ensure traceability and safe rollbacks.

Useful facts: Cart service uses Redis for persistence; Redis health flag redisConnected signals readiness; User service uses Redis for unique-id generation and MongoDB for user data; Dockerfile for cart uses node:14 as base.

INGEST: Useful facts from reflections: Cart service uses Redis for persistence; Redis health flag redisConnected signals readiness; User service uses Redis for unique-id generation and MongoDB for user data; Dockerfile for cart uses node:14 as base; Patch workflows require diff-based patches, backups, and patch diffs for traceability and safe rollbacks; End-to-end correlation IDs are now known as a critical observability lever.
INGEST: Shipping-detection guidance: combine SKU-prefix checks with shipping-label hints; maintain patch-diff based changes with backups for traceability and revertability.

INGEST: Reinforce patch approach with diff-based patches, backups, and patch diffs; ensure canary deployments are validated in CI before production rollout; document readiness tests and telemetry hooks for success/failure signals.

INGEST: Pre-patch syntax validation gating: require static syntax check (node -c cart/server.js or ESLint) before patch generation; require diff-based patch with backups; require preflight staging canary tests; provide a diff revert patch for quick rollback.

Reflections Curation.content: IF a playbook_amendment is non-null THEN evaluate it as accept, rewrite, or reject and label the decision with a runtime observability plan (e.g., surface where in code the change was implemented, add a test scaffold, and ensure the patch is cohesive and diff-based). Update: This reflection is accepted with plan to implement a MigrationTask and add unit tests.
IF reflections contain verified useful_facts, THEN ingest or merge them into System Knowledge; discard only with explicit justification in reasoning.
IF a playbook_amendment is non-null THEN evaluate it as accept, rewrite, or reject and document the label in reasoning.
IF end-to-end observability is incomplete THEN enforce propagation of correlation IDs (e.g., X-Correlation-Id) across all controllers and log traces, and validate traces end-to-end in CI pipelines.

IF DB pool pressure or fast-failing DB calls are observed THEN enforce bounded retries with explicit maxAttempts and monotonic backoff (e.g., cap at 5 attempts with short backoff, and propagate failure upstream with a structured error).

IF an item SKU starts with a shipping prefix (case-insensitive) OR item label contains 'Shipping' THEN classify as shipping-related and ensure cart validation logic routes to shipping-aware checks (do not rely on a single field).

IF item payloads show SKU/name variations (e.g., SHIP-001 vs SHIP-XYZ) THEN validate shipping-detection logic against multiple fields (SKU prefixes AND labels) and document inline examples in code comments.

IF multiple shipping-related domain implementations exist THEN create a MigrationTask to consolidate to a single canonical shipping logic, require a diff-based patch for the canonical Calculator/Shipping module and CI tests; deliver one unified patch file for Calculator and one for its callers.
IF shipping-detection rules align with correct_approach then anchor future amendments to the correct_approach and tag amendments as accept/rewrite/reject in reasoning.

SYNTHESIS: Root-cause and action blueprint distilled from multiple reflections: patch-generation drift due to missing pre-patch syntax validation; plan enforces (a) pre-patch syntax check (node -c cart/server.js or ESLint) before patch drafting, (b) cohesive, atomic diff-based patches with explicit backups, (c) a staged canary rollout with a quick rollback artifact, (d) anchoring amendments to the correct_approach with an explicit acceptance path and unit-test plan. In practice, implement a single diff patch for the startup-token fix, validate in a staging namespace, and proceed through a canary with observability hooks; roll back with the known-good orig if needed. This bullet consolidates prior analyses and serves as the canonical guide for future patches.
